ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Sustainable life Cycle Design and Research II: Session II builds upon a basic understanding of e-Waste built in Session I to examine solutions to the global problem. Students of many disciplines, industrial designers, political science, engineers, journalists, etc. are asked to engage with their own solutions. The instructor, Willie Cade, is the Co-Chair of the United Nations Environmental Program?s project on environmentally sound computer reuse. Graduate students enrolled in this class will have the opportunity to contribute real world data as a basis for further understanding. Graduate Section.
